title: Icon snapping reaches what the icon mock draws
goal: Inside an icon frame the Pen now lands on whole units, keylines and other shapes' points with nothing to switch on. The Draw an icon on the grid mock goes further: a Snap to row (Grid, Keylines, Geometry) to turn each pull on or off, a small readout beside the pointer naming the place it will land, and shapes' edges and centres as targets as well as their points.
notes: Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/icon-draw-wt.html (Grid & snap group, steps 3 to 6 and 10). Built so far: Sources/PhotonzCore/IconSnap.swift (whole units from the frame corner, keylines while shown, other paths' anchors; reach 6 view points capped at 1 unit) handed to PenSession.iconSnap by CanvasPen.refreshPenSnapping. Only the Pen uses it; rectangle/ellipse drags in icon frames still use their own magnets. Also seen: right after a shape closes it stays picked, so a Pen press on its corner grabs that corner (path edit owns the press) instead of starting a new shape there, which is exactly how the mock starts its second circle (step 6); the walk works round it with Escape. 2026-10-15: IconSnapChoices + shape edges/centres + readout in Sources/PhotonzCore/IconSnap.swift; IconSnapStore (Sources/Photonz/IconSnapStore.swift); View > Snap in Icons in EditorCommands; shape drags in icons via CanvasNSView.snappedAnnotationPoint; pill in CanvasDrawLanding.swift. Walk shapes-snap-in-an-icon-walk. Only Command vs Control (the card) is left. 2026-11-07: dots on crossings are IconUnits.crossings, drawn in CanvasIconUnits.swift by iconUnitDotLayer above the keylines; Grid choice reaches the canvas as iconSnapsToUnits; readout centre words in IconSnap.readout(for:); actions snapToGridOff/On. Measure: Scripts/measure-icon-dots.py with two captures and the artboard box.
acceptance: The mock's Snap to choices exist and each one turns its pull on or off, placed where the placement contract puts them
While a point is being placed in an icon frame, a readout beside the pointer names the whole-unit place it will land, as in the mock's step 4
A point near another shape's edge or centre lands on it, as the mock's step 6 shows
Command suspends snapping inside an icon frame, as everywhere else on the canvas (settled on 2026-10-20, when the waiting cards were taken as recommended), and the mock's Control is not used for it

MEASURED, and today's window fails it (0 dots): with the Grid on and Snap in Icons Grid on, a capture of a 24 unit artboard shows a dot on each of the 441 unit crossings of the live area, none outside it, and none with Snap in Icons Grid off
A point that lands on the artboard's centre line says so in the readout, as the mock's step 10 does: 12, 16 · center
Pressing on a shape's corner with a shape tool in hand starts the new shape there, as the mock's step 6 does, with no Escape first

log.note: Review before building: the mock draws Grid & snap as a right-panel group, but the placement contract puts snapping in the View menu (the inspector is what the pick IS), and the grid's own controls are under an open card, so the three Snap to choices became View > Snap in Icons > Grid, Keylines, Geometry, Photoshop's View > Snap To shape. The mock's steps 4 to 6 use Rectangle and Ellipse, which still had their screenshot magnets in icon frames, so shape drags now use IconSnap too. A Mac catch for the mock's Control key: Control held at the press is a right-click, so it cannot start a drag; that goes on the card. Whole-unit edges only, so the promise that every place is whole survives.

Built: IconSnap (PhotonzCore) gains IconSnapChoices (grid, keylines, geometry), shapes' box edges and middles as axis lines, whole-unit centres as point targets, landing(nearest:zoom:) saying whether anything placed the point, and readout(for:) ('15, 13'). PhotonzDocument.iconSnap gathers path anchors, box corners, oval quarter points and line ends from unturned shapes. App: IconSnapStore preference, View > Snap in Icons submenu (Keylines dimmed while hidden), CanvasNSView.iconSnap(at:) shared by the Pen and snappedAnnotationPoint (shape drags in icons; endpoint reshapes keep their old magnets), landing ring for shape tools in icons, and an accent pill beside the ring and at a dragged shape's corner (CanvasDrawLanding). Walk: expectLanding takes says; actions snapToGeometryOff/On (the menu bar is frozen in a background walk).

Verified: IconSnapTests 39 green, MenuToggleNamesTests, PlaytestScriptTests; full suite 13232 green. New walk shapes-snap-in-an-icon-walk green at Next defaults: pill reads 9, 10 / 12, 8 / 16, 17, geometry off rounds to 17, 17, SVG has the box at translate(9 10) 6x3 and circles at (8 4) d8 and (6 7) d6 (centred on the box corner, the mock's step 6). pen-lands-on-whole-units-in-an-icon-walk updated: its last point at 18.4 units now lands on the triangle's bottom edge at 19 (the new edge pull), so the expected path ends 8 13. 16 icon walks and 33 shape/pen/landing walks green. Looked at icon-snap-1-aim, 2-dragging and 3-on-an-edge captures: the pill reads white on the accent beside the ring, clear of the ring.

Acceptance: items 1 to 3 done (Snap to choices in the View menu per the placement contract, readout beside the pointer, edges and centres as targets). Item 4 is the open card on Command vs Control. Filed a-box-or-circle-can-be-drawn-out-from-its-centre (mock steps 5 and 6 draw circles out from their centres). Left rough, not filed: a line held at 45 degrees with Shift in an icon lands off whole units; at 800% a keyline can catch a point most of a unit away (the existing reach rule); the picked-shape-corner press clash noted when this task was filed was not looked at.

Built and pushed (50a05afe): in icon frames shapes and Pen points snap to whole units, keylines, and drawn shapes' corners, edges and centres; a pill beside the landing ring names the spot (9, 10); View > Snap in Icons > Grid, Keylines, Geometry toggles each. Verified by full suite (13232), shapes-snap-in-an-icon-walk at Next defaults and 49 related walks. Reproduced before building: pen-lands-on-whole-units-in-an-icon-walk and shapes-snap-in-an-icon-walk both pass on today's build, so the 2026-10-31 rotating check failure no longer happens. Command needed no code: command-frees-snapping-in-an-icon-walk proves a box, Pen points and a move stay put with it held (SVG translate(10.6 11.6), 5.9 x 2.7; path 4.3, 17.4 and 8.6, 17.7) and the next point without it goes back to a whole unit.

Measured dots with Scripts/measure-icon-dots.py on dots-1-on-sc.png against the same window with Snap in Icons Grid off, box 591 518 1359 1286: 441 dots, 0 in the margin, 0 pixels changed off a crossing, PASS. The weak version (no dots) reads 0 and FAILS. First pass had the dots under the keylines, hiding those crossings; moved over them, as the mock stacks them.

Chose to leave a Pen press on a corner of the path it just closed as it is (grabs the corner) over starting a new path, because an active path's anchor answers the Pen in Photoshop and Illustrator too and a picked path is reachable with the Pen on purpose. Reproduced: two clicks from the corner of a just closed triangle gave no second path; Escape first works. Shape tools were never affected: a press on a picked box's corner with Ellipse starts the circle there, now walked with no Escape.

Chose dots only inside the live area, as the mock's igDots rect does, and none under 10 points a unit or above 4000 crossings because they turn to speckle and cost every pan. Looked at pictures: dots-on, dots-off, beside-the-mock, center-readout, command-free, and a-24's 10-dark-frame: dots read on white, near black and over a filled shape, on the crossings.

Two walks read CRASHED during this run (dots-on-an-icon-s-crossings-walk, command-frees-snapping-in-an-icon-walk) with no crash report. That was me: killing a run stopped only its child, so two playtest-all runs shared the probe and quit each other's app. Each passed in the other run, the dots walk passed three times alone, ask-tweaks-an-icon-walk (which I killed) passed on rerun. Not an app bug.
